subject.title: fix(codex): keep progress replies from ending active turns

question: Should Codex message-tool-only completion require explicit `final=true`, or preserve implicit terminal delivery and rely on prompt-only steering?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100156 solve the same reproduced bug with mutually exclusive durable behavior for otherwise valid message-tool sends; automation cannot safely select that runtime contract.

options.title: Explicit final contract
options.body: Make progress sends non-terminal and require `final=true` for completed current-source replies, scoped only to Codex message-tool-only runs.

options.title: Prompt-only steering
options.body: Keep every delivered current-source send terminal and use the narrower prompt-only change to discourage progress sends.

recommendation.title: Explicit final contract
recommendation.body: Make progress sends non-terminal and require `final=true` for completed current-source replies, scoped only to Codex message-tool-only runs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged source-reply completion work established the current terminal-recognition contract being changed.
